description: This PHP class defines a ParamRule used for validating parameters within an API context. It encapsulates details such as the parameter key, associated validation rules, default value, and composite validation type. The class facilitates constructing and configuring validation rules for API request parameters within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ParamRule
classes.description: Represents validation rules for a specific API parameter, including its key, associated rules, default value, and composite validation strategy.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize ParamRule with a parameter key and validation rules.

methods.name: getParamKey
methods.description: Returns the parameter key associated with this validation rule.

methods.name: setParamKey
methods.description: Sets the parameter key for this validation rule.

methods.name: getRules
methods.description: Returns the array of validation Rule objects.

methods.name: setRules
methods.description: Sets the array of validation Rule objects.

methods.name: getDefault
methods.description: Returns the default value for the parameter.

methods.name: setDefault
methods.description: Sets the default value for the parameter.

methods.name: getCompositeClass
methods.description: Returns the composite validation class used for combining rules.

methods.name: setCompositeClass
methods.description: Sets the composite validation class; throws ValidatorException if value is invalid.
